entries.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original raster color field for Vimi, an English adult K-pop dance social Android app. Create ONE full-bleed rectangular 3:2 premium neon gradient color field, covering every pixel. Strong luminous hot orchid pink at the left (#F575CF), blending into vivid light violet in the middle (#B095FF), into cool icy electric cyan at the far right (#85DDF3). The pink and violet dominate; cyan occupies the final quarter. Smooth controlled liquid-light transitions with just one very subtle broad flowing bend, elegant digital club-poster color, bright enough for deep-violet-black text to be readable. Perfectly smooth, absolutely no texture or grain. Flat raster design material, NOT a photograph, NOT a button mockup. No black corners, no outer margins, no panels, no white, no text, no logo, no symbols, no objects, no stars, no people, no manga, no 3D chrome, no UI or device. This image itself will be clipped by native layout into buttons/selected controls and softly composited behind dark pages. Make the whole rectangle luminous consistent color; do not bake any rounded corners or shadow.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original portrait photographic welcome artwork for Vimi, an adult dance community mobile app. Primary request: a magnetic candid dance rehearsal photograph with an energetic K-pop social atmosphere and striking neon stage lighting. Two fictional adult dancers aged 24-29, an East Asian woman in the foreground in a dark cropped but ordinary opaque tee and loose cargo trousers, a Black woman behind in a violet oversized tee and streetwear trousers, smiling slightly while exchanging a movement cue mid rehearsal. Both naturally proportioned, distinct realistic faces, hands clearly separated from bodies and from each other; no extreme contortion. Fashionable contemporary dance studio at night, clean dark room, pink and violet LED edge lights, a soft electric cyan rim, believable natural skin under colored lights, textured cotton clothes and real flyaway hair. Waist-up to knee framing with both heads well inside the middle upper two thirds so app crop never cuts off heads; dancers on center and right. Purple-magenta atmosphere, deep midnight purple negative space at bottom quarter for native app typography. Editorial music-culture photography shot on a 35mm lens, caught in motion, realistic camera exposure, crisp face, natural skin pores, no beauty blur. No literal stars, no glowing outlines around bodies, no sci-fi props, no anime, no comic, no illustration, no AI-looking porcelain skin, no plastic 3D, no invented brand names, no logos, no text, no UI, no device frame, no crowd or additional limbs. Aspect ratio 2:3 portrait.
entries.classification: original fictional adult photographic brand artwork

entries.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original wide dance challenge cover for Vimi, an adult dance social app with a dark neon pink-violet-cyan identity. A thrilling realistic photograph of three fictional adult friends aged 24-30 rehearsing K-pop choreography together at night. On the right two thirds: an East Asian woman in a magenta fitted opaque T-shirt and charcoal baggy trousers, a Latino man in an off-white loose tee and black cargo trousers, and a second East Asian man in a violet oversized shirt. Energetic grounded hip-hop dance poses caught between steps, arms and hands visibly separate, anatomically accurate. Camera at chest height, three-quarter body framing, subjects' heads comfortably inside frame. Clean black-violet rehearsal studio, a single long pink LED light overhead and cyan light from one side; realistic natural skin, cotton textures, authentic facial expressions, not posing for camera, only small directional motion blur on fabric. Left third kept mostly empty dark violet so native text may overlay in app, bottom edge also dark. Contrast-rich neon color, cinematic music editorial, looks like a real professional dance community rather than a wellness brochure. No text, no labels, no numbers, no logos, no icons, no UI, no phone, no laser grid, no sci-fi tunnel, no floating holograms, no anime or comic, no plastic 3D, no face smoothing, no extra people or limbs. Wide 3:2 landscape composition.
entries.classification: original fictional adult photographic brand artwork

entries.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: Vimi original Android application icon/brand monogram. Edit the supplied image. Keep the exact recognizable smooth v silhouette and proportions centered with the same generous safe margins. Replace its flat white fill with a crisp luminous neon gradient that sweeps from electric pink through lilac violet into pale icy cyan, vibrant and bright against a very dark midnight purple (#100A20) full square background. Faint tasteful violet ambient depth in the background only. The v must stay a simple flat graphic, elegant music-culture and dance-social brand, perfectly clear at 48px, neither cartoon nor a complex illustration. No new shapes, no extra lettering, no words, no face, no person, no music notes, no external border or rounded app-square frame (launcher masks it), no bevel, no chrome, no grain, no star glitter, no plastic 3D. Full-bleed square asset. Preserve a quiet dark background so the bright gradient v dominates.
